native_process.identity_note: The source-based test build and the standalone signer build select their own dependency feature graphs and replace the un-hashed role executables. All three post-test hashes differ from the preceding production-feature build, and both identities are retained. These are source-based debug process results, not execution evidence for the shipping-feature or release artifacts. Exact-revision shipping artifact validation remains a CI gate.
coverage_assertions: Both anchor modes and the configured delay/PREVRANDAO schedule are exercised in bounded parts.
The expired-source case executes 2,000 L2 blocks in four 500-block parts and asserts the terminal source in its first part is more than 256 L1 blocks old.
The manager rejects that unavailable old anchor; complete ancestry to a recent anchor allows settlement.
Fresh network-denied signer processes validate each part; missing selected or bridge-only header evidence rejects without an attestation.
The independently started follower compares every L2 block hash, state root and PREVRANDAO, all permanent imported L1 hashes, and 32 ordinary application observations across an L1 rule transition.
Nested CREATE2 fee quotes retain settlement and replay assertions; tampered ABI calldata reaches the real signer and is rejected.
Partial consumption requires root-bound proof updates; same-block middle-group resumption and restart accounting are exercised.
native_process.evidence_note: The log retains test selection and results. Successful test checkpoint stdout is captured by libtest; coverage above describes the executed assertions, not independently retained per-part timing measurements.
